description: This file defines the WidgetBaseInterface interface for Drupal field widget plugins, including method signatures for form creation, value extraction, error flagging, and widget state management.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Creates a form element for a field, pre-populating defaults if the entity is new.

methods.name: extractFormValues
methods.description: Extracts field values from submitted form data.

methods.name: flagErrors
methods.description: Reports validation errors against form elements.

methods.name: getWidgetState
methods.description: Retrieves processing info about the widget from form state.

methods.name: setWidgetState
methods.description: Stores processing info about the widget in form state.
